current.name: INTERACTION_RESPONSE_CURRENT
current.effect: incremented by one when below the pending value

pending.name: INTERACTION_RESPONSE_PENDING
pending.effect: upper bound compared by the helper

semantics: The helper saves D0, reads the current and pending interaction response bytes, increments the current byte only when it is below the pending byte, restores D0, and returns.
conclusion: The former 0x001B0434-0x001B044D UNKNOWN range is the response-target convergence step that precedes the active interaction selector update.
